title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts naturally per location (warm dorm light → cool van light → studio fluorescents → bright stage lights).

STYLE:
Fast-paced time-lapse montage feel — quick cuts stitched together across locations, sped-up transitional movement between them. Instead of synced dialogue, her voice plays as reflective voiceover narration over the visuals, tying the day together. Energy builds progressively from sleepy morning to high-adrenaline stage finish.

Character

CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, elegant yet lovely Korean features, dewy glass skin, coral pink lips, big eyes. Outfit changes naturally per location: cozy loungewear at the dorm, casual comfortable clothes in the van, modest athletic wear in the practice room, and a stage outfit for the final segment — each fully covering arms and torso.

Setting Progression

Dorm room (morning) → van interior (daytime) → practice room (afternoon) → backstage/stage (night).

Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)

1. *(~2s, dorm, propped camera, sleepy morning light)* She stretches, rubbing her eyes, hair messy. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dorm, handheld, quick motion)* She moves through her morning routine in fast, sped-up cuts — brushing hair, grabbing a bag. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, van interior, handheld, window light)* She sits by the window, phone in hand, soft daylight passing over her face. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* Close-up on her hand adjusting a playlist on her phone, light flickering through the window. No narration — ambient road sound only.

5. *(~2s, practice room, handheld, energetic)* She's mid-movement rehearsing choreography, camera catching quick glimpses of the mirror wall. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, practice room, propped camera, water break)* She wipes sweat, drinks water, breathless but smiling. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, backstage, handheld, quick transition)* Hair and makeup blur past in quick cuts, staff moving around her, adrenaline building. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, stage, wide-to-close, high energy finish)* Bright stage lights, her silhouette stepping out as the camera catches a final glimpse before cutting to black. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

es.content:
CAMARA:
Sensación de videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm, sostenida a mano. POV de CHASE sosteniendo ella misma la cámara en cada ubicación, ocasionalmente apoyada brevemente para momentos sin manos. Temblor de mano, encuadre desalineado, cambios de enfoque tardíos, zooms torpes, encuadres ocasionalmente cortados en la cara, tomas imperfectas. La videocámara nunca aparece en pantalla.

LOOK:
Calidad de cinta suave, ligeramente borrosa, con leve ruido de cinta, altas luces con bloom, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, tonos de piel realistas — la iluminación cambia de forma natural según la ubicación (luz cálida del dormitorio → luz fría de la van → fluorescentes del estudio → luces intensas del escenario).

STYLE:
Sensación de montaje time-lapse de ritmo rápido — cortes breves unidos entre distintas ubicaciones, con movimiento transicional acelerado entre ellas. En lugar de diálogo sincronizado, su voz suena como narración en voiceover reflexiva sobre las imágenes, uniendo todo el día. La energía aumenta progresivamente desde una mañana somnolienta hasta un final de escenario de alta adrenalina.

Character

CHASE — ídolo coreana, 20s. Cabello negro largo y liso, rasgos coreanos elegantes y encantadores, piel de cristal con aspecto húmedo, labios rosa coral, ojos grandes. El vestuario cambia de forma natural según la ubicación: ropa cómoda de estar en casa en el dormitorio, ropa casual y cómoda en la van, ropa deportiva modesta en la sala de práctica y un outfit de escenario para el segmento final — cada uno cubriendo completamente brazos y torso.

Setting Progression

Habitación del dormitorio (mañana) → interior de la van (día) → sala de práctica (tarde) → backstage/escenario (noche).

Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)

1. *(~2s, dormitorio, cámara apoyada, luz somnolienta de la mañana)* Se estira, frotándose los ojos, con el cabello despeinado. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dormitorio, handheld, movimiento rápido)* Hace su rutina matutina en cortes rápidos y acelerados — cepillándose el cabello, agarrando una bolsa. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, interior de la van, handheld, luz de la ventana)* Se sienta junto a la ventana, con el teléfono en la mano, mientras la luz suave del día pasa sobre su rostro. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* Primer plano de su mano ajustando una playlist en su teléfono, con la luz parpadeando a través de la ventana. Sin narración — solo sonido ambiente de la carretera.

5. *(~2s, sala de práctica, handheld, enérgico)* Está en pleno movimiento ensayando la coreografía, mientras la cámara capta breves destellos de la pared de espejos. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, sala de práctica, cámara apoyada, pausa para beber agua)* Se seca el sudor, bebe agua, sin aliento pero sonriendo. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, backstage, handheld, transición rápida)* El peinado y el maquillaje pasan difuminados en cortes rápidos, el personal moviéndose a su alrededor, la adrenalina en aumento. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, escenario, de plano general a primer plano, cierre de alta energía)* Luces intensas del escenario, su silueta saliendo mientras la cámara capta un último destello antes de cortar a negro. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

fr.content:
CAMÉRA :
Caméscope DV 16 mm à l’esthétique handheld. POV de CHASE tenant elle-même la caméra dans chaque lieu, parfois posée brièvement pour des moments sans les mains. Tremblements de main, cadrage désaligné, mises au point retardées, zooms maladroits, cadrages coupant parfois le visage, plans imparfaits. Le caméscope n’apparaît jamais à l’écran.

LOOK :
Qualité de bande douce, légèrement floue, léger bruit de bande, hautes lumières qui bavent, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué, tons de peau réalistes — l’éclairage évolue naturellement selon le lieu (lumière chaude du dortoir → lumière froide de la van → néons du studio → lumières vives de la scène).

STYLE :
Sensation de montage time-lapse au rythme rapide — coupes rapides assemblées d’un lieu à l’autre, mouvements de transition accélérés entre les scènes. Au lieu de dialogues synchronisés, sa voix sert de narration en voice-over, réfléchie, qui accompagne les images et relie la journée. L’énergie monte progressivement, d’un matin somnolent à une fin de scène à haute adrénaline.

Character

CHASE — idole coréenne, vingtaine. Longs cheveux noirs raides, traits coréens élégants et charmants, peau de verre rosée et lumineuse, lèvres rose corail, grands yeux. La tenue change naturellement selon le lieu : tenue d’intérieur confortable au dortoir, vêtements décontractés et confortables dans la van, tenue sportive modeste dans la salle de répétition, et tenue de scène pour le segment final — chaque tenue couvrant entièrement les bras et le torse.

Setting Progression

Chambre du dortoir (matin) → intérieur de la van (journée) → salle de répétition (après-midi) → coulisses/scène (nuit).

Storyboard (narration en voice-over sur les images)

1. *(~2s, dortoir, caméra posée, lumière matinale somnolente)* Elle s’étire en se frottant les yeux, les cheveux en bataille. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "Chaque journée commence de la même façon — beaucoup trop tôt."

2. *(~2s, dortoir, handheld, mouvement rapide)* Elle enchaîne sa routine du matin en coupes rapides et accélérées — se brosser les cheveux, attraper un sac. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "Se préparer, tout prendre, et y aller."

3. *(~2s, intérieur de la van, handheld, lumière de la fenêtre)* Elle est assise près de la fenêtre, téléphone à la main, la lumière du jour glissant doucement sur son visage. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "La van est pratiquement ma deuxième maison, à ce stade."

4. *(~1.5s, van, insert macro)* Gros plan sur sa main en train de changer une playlist sur son téléphone, la lumière vacillant à travers la fenêtre. Pas de narration — uniquement le son ambiant de la route.

5. *(~2s, salle de répétition, handheld, énergique)* Elle est en plein mouvement, en train de répéter la chorégraphie, la caméra captant de brefs aperçus du mur de miroirs. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "Ensuite, ce sont des heures de répétition jusqu’à ce que mes jambes lâchent."

6. *(~2s, salle de répétition, caméra posée, pause hydratation)* Elle s’essuie la sueur, boit de l’eau, essoufflée mais souriante. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "Mais d’une certaine façon, je ne me lasse jamais de cette partie."

7. *(~2s, coulisses, handheld, transition rapide)* Coiffure et maquillage défilent en coupes rapides, les membres du staff s’affairent autour d’elle, l’adrénaline monte. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "Et puis, soudain, c’est l’heure du show."

8. *(~2s, scène, du plan large au plan rapproché, fin très énergique)* Lumières de scène éclatantes, sa silhouette s’avance tandis que la caméra capte un dernier aperçu avant de couper au noir. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : "C’est ça, la partie qui rend tout le reste si précieux."

ja.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラを手持ちで撮ったような質感。各ロケーションを通して、CHASE本人がカメラを持っているPOV。ときどき手を離して、短いハンズフリーの瞬間もある。手ブレ、ずれたフレーミング、遅れたフォーカス送り、不器用なズーム、たまに顔が切れる構図、完璧ではないショット。ビデオカメラ本体は画面に映らない。

LOOK:
やわらかく、少しぼやけたテープ質感。かすかなテープノイズ、ハイライトのにじみ、ちらつくオート露出、抑えめのコントラスト、自然な肌色。照明はロケーションごとに自然に変化する（暖かい寮の光 → 冷たいバン内の光 → スタジオの蛍光灯 → 明るいステージライト）。

STYLE:
テンポの速いタイムラプス・モンタージュのような雰囲気。各ロケーションをまたいで素早いカットをつなぎ、移動の間もスピード感のあるトランジションで見せる。同期したセリフの代わりに、彼女の声は映像の上に重なる内省的なボイスオーバーとして流れ、一日全体をつないでいく。眠い朝から高揚感のあるステージの締めへと、エネルギーが段階的に高まっていく。

Character

CHASE — 韓国のアイドル、20代。長いストレートの黒髪、上品でありながら愛らしい韓国的な顔立ち、みずみずしいガラス肌、コーラルピンクの唇、大きな瞳。衣装はロケーションごとに自然に変わる：寮ではくつろいだルームウェア、バンではカジュアルで動きやすい服、練習室では控えめなスポーツウェア、最後のシーンではステージ衣装。いずれも腕と胴体を完全に覆う。

Setting Progression

寮の部屋（朝）→ バンの車内（日中）→ 練習室（午後）→ バックステージ／ステージ（夜）。

Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)

1. *(~2s, 寮, 置いたカメラ, 眠い朝の光)* 彼女は伸びをして目をこすり、髪は乱れている。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, 寮, 手持ち, 素早い動き)* 髪をとかし、バッグをつかむなど、朝の支度をテンポよく早回しのカットで見せる。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, バンの車内, 手持ち, 窓からの光)* 彼女は窓際に座り、スマホを手にしている。やわらかな日差しが顔の上を流れていく。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, バン, マクロの挿入カット)* スマホでプレイリストを調整する彼女の手元のクローズアップ。窓越しの光がちらつく。ナレーションなし — 環境音と道路音のみ。

5. *(~2s, 練習室, 手持ち, エネルギッシュ)* 振り付けのリハーサル中で、カメラには鏡張りの壁が一瞬ずつ映り込む。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, 練習室, 置いたカメラ, 水分補給の休憩)* 汗をぬぐい、水を飲む。息は上がっているが、笑顔。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, バックステージ, 手持ち, 素早いトランジション)* ヘアメイクが素早いカットで流れ、スタッフが周囲を行き交い、アドレナリンが高まっていく。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, ステージ, ワイドからクローズへ, ハイエナジーな締め)* 明るいステージライト。彼女のシルエットが一歩踏み出し、カメラが最後の一瞬を捉えてからブラックアウトする。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

ko.content:
---
카메라:
DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더를 손에 들고 촬영한 듯한 느낌. 각 장소마다 CHASE가 직접 카메라를 들고 있는 1인칭 시점(POV)이며, 가끔 손이 자유로운 순간에는 잠깐 고정해 둔다. 손떨림, 어긋난 구도, 늦게 맞춰지는 포커스, 어설픈 줌, 가끔 얼굴이 잘리는 프레이밍, 완벽하지 않은 샷. 캠코더는 화면에 절대 등장하지 않는다.

룩:
부드럽고 약간 흐릿한 테이프 화질, 희미한 테이프 노이즈, 번진 하이라이트, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 절제된 대비, 현실적인 피부 톤 — 조명은 장소에 따라 자연스럽게 변한다(따뜻한 기숙사 조명 → 차가운 밴 내부 조명 → 스튜디오 형광등 → 밝은 무대 조명).

스타일:
빠른 템포의 타임랩스 몽타주 느낌 — 장소를 넘나들며 빠른 컷이 이어지고, 그 사이 이동은 속도가 붙은 전환 동작으로 표현된다. 싱크된 대사 대신, 그녀의 목소리는 하루를 하나로 엮는 성찰적인 보이스오버 내레이션으로 깔린다. 에너지는 졸린 아침에서 시작해 고강도 무대 피날레로 갈수록 점점 고조된다.

캐릭터

CHASE — 한국 아이돌, 20대. 길고 곧은 검은 머리, 우아하면서도 사랑스러운 한국적 이목구비, 촉촉한 글래스 스킨, 코럴 핑크 립, 큰 눈. 의상은 장소에 따라 자연스럽게 바뀐다: 기숙사에서는 편안한 라운지웨어, 밴 안에서는 캐주얼하고 편한 옷, 연습실에서는 단정한 운동복, 마지막 장면의 무대에서는 무대 의상 — 모두 팔과 상체를 완전히 가린다.

장소 진행

기숙사 방(아침) → 밴 내부(낮) → 연습실(오후) → 백스테이지/무대(밤).

스토리보드 (비주얼 위에 보이스오버 내레이션)

1. *(~2초, 기숙사, 고정된 카메라, 졸린 아침빛)* 그녀가 기지개를 켜며 눈을 비빈다. 머리는 헝클어져 있다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2초, 기숙사, 핸드헬드, 빠른 움직임)* 그녀가 아침 루틴을 빠른 속도의 컷으로 이어가며 움직인다 — 머리를 빗고, 가방을 챙긴다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2초, 밴 내부, 핸드헬드, 창문빛)* 그녀가 창가에 앉아 휴대폰을 손에 들고 있고, 부드러운 낮빛이 얼굴 위로 스쳐 지나간다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5초, 밴, 매크로 인서트)* 창문을 통해 깜빡이는 빛 속에서, 휴대폰에서 플레이리스트를 조정하는 그녀의 손 클로즈업. 내레이션 없음 — 주변 도로 소리만.

5. *(~2초, 연습실, 핸드헬드, 에너지 넘침)* 그녀가 안무를 연습하며 동작 중간에 있고, 카메라는 거울 벽의 짧은 장면들을 빠르게 포착한다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2초, 연습실, 고정된 카메라, 물 마시는 휴식)* 그녀가 땀을 닦고 물을 마신다. 숨은 차지만 웃고 있다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2초, 백스테이지, 핸드헬드, 빠른 전환)* 헤어와 메이크업이 빠른 컷으로 스쳐 지나가고, 스태프들이 그녀 주변을 오가며 아드레날린이 고조된다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2초, 무대, 와이드에서 클로즈업으로, 강한 에너지의 마무리)* 밝은 무대 조명, 카메라가 마지막 순간 그녀의 실루엣을 포착한 뒤 블랙으로 컷된다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."
---

pt.content:
CAMERA:
Sensação de câmera de mão em fita DV 16mm. POV de CHASE segurando a câmera ela mesma em cada local, ocasionalmente apoiada por breves momentos sem as mãos. Tremor de mão, enquadramento desalinhado, pulls de foco atrasados, zooms desajeitados, enquadramento ocasional cortando o rosto, takes imperfeitos. A filmadora nunca aparece em cena.

LOOK:
Qualidade suave, levemente borrada, de fita, com ruído sutil de tape, highlights estourados, autoexposição piscando, contraste suave, tons de pele realistas — a iluminação muda naturalmente conforme o local (luz quente do dormitório → luz fria da van → fluorescentes da sala de ensaio → luzes fortes do palco).

STYLE:
Sensação de montagem em time-lapse de ritmo acelerado — cortes rápidos costurados entre os locais, movimento de transição acelerado entre eles. Em vez de diálogo sincronizado, a voz dela entra como narração reflexiva em voiceover sobre as imagens, conectando o dia inteiro. A energia cresce progressivamente de uma manhã sonolenta até um final de palco cheio de adrenalina.

Character

CHASE — idol coreana, 20 e poucos anos. Cabelo preto longo e liso, traços coreanos elegantes e delicados, pele viçosa com efeito glass skin, lábios rosa coral, olhos grandes. A roupa muda naturalmente conforme o local: loungewear confortável no dormitório, roupas casuais e confortáveis na van, roupa esportiva modesta na sala de ensaio e um figurino de palco no segmento final — cada um cobrindo totalmente braços e torso.

Setting Progression

Quarto do dormitório (manhã) → interior da van (durante o dia) → sala de ensaio (tarde) → bastidores/palco (noite).

Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)

1. *(~2s, dormitório, câmera apoiada, luz sonolenta da manhã)* Ela se espreguiça, esfregando os olhos, cabelo bagunçado. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dormitório, handheld, movimento rápido)* Ela segue sua rotina matinal em cortes rápidos e acelerados — escovando o cabelo, pegando uma bolsa. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, interior da van, handheld, luz da janela)* Ela está sentada perto da janela, com o celular na mão, a luz suave do dia passando pelo rosto. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* Close-up da mão ajustando uma playlist no celular, com a luz piscando pela janela. Sem narração — apenas som ambiente da estrada.

5. *(~2s, sala de ensaio, handheld, energético)* Ela está no meio do movimento, ensaiando a coreografia, com a câmera captando vislumbres rápidos da parede de espelhos. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, sala de ensaio, câmera apoiada, pausa para água)* Ela enxuga o suor, bebe água, sem fôlego, mas sorrindo. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, bastidores, handheld, transição rápida)* Cabelo e maquiagem passam em cortes rápidos, a equipe se movimenta ao redor dela, a adrenalina aumenta. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, palco, wide-to-close, final de alta energia)* Luzes fortes do palco, a silhueta dela entrando em cena enquanto a câmera captura um último vislumbre antes de cortar para preto. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

CAMERA:
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持感。全程以 CHASE 自己拿着相机的 POV 视角拍摄，偶尔短暂架起，形成免手持的片刻。画面有手部抖动、构图偏移、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦、偶尔拍到脸部被切掉的构图，以及不完美的镜头。摄像机本身从不出现在画面中。

LOOK:
柔和、略微模糊的磁带画质，轻微磁带噪点，高光泛光，自动曝光闪烁，对比度偏低，真实肤色——光线会随地点自然变化（宿舍暖光 → 面包车冷光 → 练习室荧光灯 → 舞台强光）。

STYLE:
快节奏的 time-lapse montage 感——通过快速剪辑把不同地点串联起来，地点之间的过渡动作被加速处理。不是同步对白，而是她的声音以反思性的 voiceover 旁白形式覆盖在画面上，把整天串联起来。情绪能量逐步累积，从昏昏欲睡的清晨一路推进到高肾上腺素的舞台收尾。

Character

CHASE — 韩国偶像，20 多岁。黑色长直发，精致又可爱的韩系五官，水润玻璃肌，珊瑚粉唇，大眼睛。服装会随地点自然变化：宿舍里是舒适家居服，面包车里是休闲舒适的衣服，练习室里是得体的运动装，最后一段是舞台服装——每套都完整遮住手臂和躯干。

Setting Progression

宿舍房间（早晨）→ 面包车内（白天）→ 练习室（下午）→ 后台/舞台（夜晚）。

Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)

1. *(~2s, dorm, propped camera, sleepy morning light)* 她伸着懒腰，揉着眼睛，头发乱糟糟的。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dorm, handheld, quick motion)* 她在晨间例行流程中快速切换镜头——梳头、拿包。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, van interior, handheld, window light)* 她坐在窗边，手里拿着手机，柔和的日光掠过她的脸。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* 特写她的手在手机上调整播放列表，光线透过车窗忽明忽暗。No narration — ambient road sound only.

5. *(~2s, practice room, handheld, energetic)* 她正在练习舞蹈编排，动作进行到一半，镜头捕捉到镜墙的快速掠影。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, practice room, propped camera, water break)* 她擦汗、喝水，气喘吁吁却带着笑。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, backstage, handheld, quick transition)* 发型和妆容在快速剪辑中一闪而过，工作人员在她身边来来往往，肾上腺素不断攀升。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, stage, wide-to-close, high energy finish)* 明亮的舞台灯光，她的剪影迈步登场，镜头在切黑前捕捉到最后一瞥。VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."
